svg.title: Figure 2: sparsely supervised diffusion
svg.desc: Flow matching and SSD use the same full noise input and U-Net. Flow matching supervises the full target velocity. SSD supervises sparse masked target differences, shown as a stack of partial views. Solid arrows indicate the forward pass; dashed arrows indicate supervision.
